title: The Succession Ceremony
summary: The flashback goes on: the Gate of Life and Death accepts Nalan Yanran, and she is to become Young Lady of the Misty Cloud Sect. An old sect rule says the Young Lady must never be involved with a man, and Elder Yun Leng reminds her of it. Nalan Jie says she will marry Xiao Yan next year, and Liu Ling learns of the betrothal. Nalan Yanran cries to Yun Yun, who tells her to get to know her fiance first and promises to back her either way. A senior's report that Xiao Yan lost his power to gather Dou Qi three years ago turns her against him. At the ceremony, before Jia Xing Tian, Fa Ma and the sect, a man exposes her betrothal. Nalan Yanran declares that it was her family's choice and that she will not honour it.
events: Nalan Yanran shows Nalan Jie her ceremony cape; Ge Ye is assigned as her guard.
Nalan Jie mentions her marriage to Xiao Yan; Yun Leng overhears and warns her of the rule against men.
Liu Ling reveals he knows of the betrothal.
Yun Yun comforts Nalan Yanran and promises to stand by her.
A senior calls Xiao Yan 'trash' who lost his Dou Qi three years ago.
At the succession ceremony, someone raises her betrothal before the guests.
Nalan Yanran publicly rejects the betrothal as her family's decision (end, in ep56 file).
